user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject an invalid date format so that only correctly formatted dates are accepted.

positive.title: System accepts a valid date format
steps: Navigate to the date input field.
Enter the date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
positive.expected_result: The date is accepted without any error.

negative.title: System rejects an invalid date format
steps: Navigate to the date input field.
Enter the date in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY'.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating an invalid date format.

edge.title: System handles a non-date string
steps: Navigate to the date input field.
Enter a non-date string such as 'abcdef'.
edge.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating an invalid date format.
